MIND. [1] [Bapt.]
Unconsciousness. θ Typhus.
Stupor ; falls asleep while being spoken to, or answering ; heavy sleep until aroused ; awakes only to again fall asleep in the midst of his answer, which he vainly endeavors to finish. θ Typhus.
Confusion of ideas ; confused as if drunk.
Cannot confine his mind ; a sort of wild, wandering feeling.
Cannot go to sleep, because he cannot get himself together. θ Orchitis. θ Typhoid.
Sensation as if there was a second self outside of patient. θ Typhus.
Feels scattered about, and tosses about to get the pieces together. θ Typhus.
He thinks his gouty legs are holding a conversation with each other ; a man, æt. 60. θ Gout.
He thinks his toe is holding a confab with his gouty thumb.
Mind wanders as soon as the eyes are closed.
Delirium, especially at night, or constant, low ; stupor. θ Typhus.
Delirium and incoherent talk. θ Typhus.
Delirious stupor or fierce delirium. θ Typhus.
Low muttering. θ Typhus.
Indisposed to think, want of power ; mind seems weak.
Aversion to mental or bodily exertion, or to hear conversation about sickness or injuries ; feeble mind ; fretful. θ Spasmodic stricture of œsophagus.
A sensation as if some person touched him gently while dozing. See 37.
Perfect indifference, does not care to do anything ; inability to fix the mind on anything.
Hopeless of recovery, and certain of death. θ Typhus.
Mentally restless, but too lifeless to move.
Restless and delirious for three weeks. θ Typhus.
Want of mental force. θ Typhus.
Worse when thinking of pains in various parts of body.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Bapt.]
Vertigo and weak feeling of entire system, especially of lower limbs and knees.
Dizzy when stooping.
Vertigo with paralysis of eyelids.
Giddiness and severe nausea. θ Typhus.
Head feels heavy, as if he could not sit up.
Dull, heavy sensation in head with drowsiness ; unfit for mental labor.
Frequent fainting ; tongue dry, brown, in morning.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Bapt.]
Peculiar feeling in head, which is never felt except during fever, excitement of brain, such as precedes delirium.
Head feels heavy as if he could not sit up, day and night, causing a wild feeling ; < from noise.
Dull, stupefying headache with fulness ; sensation as if a band were around forehead ; confusion of ideas ; stupor ; dull, heavy looking eyes, besotted expression ; feel as if had been drunk and was just recovering from its effects ; general debility and nervous prostration.
Head feels large and heavy, with numb feeling of head and face ; stitches or shocks in various parts of head.
Dull, heavy, pressive headache.
A dull, heavy feeling in head, especially forehead and malar bones ; ears feel hot, yet cold to touch ; head feels swollen ; giddiness, as if he had taken liquor, < when walking.
Dull, heavy feeling in head with general languor ; eyes pain while reading by gaslight ; 2d day.
Dull, heavy, full feeling in forehead with slight frontal headache, with sensation as if temples were pressed by thumbs ; 1st day.
Pain in forehead over left eye in region of supraorbital foramen ; darts of pain in different parts of body ; 2d day.
Slight frontal headache after having been up awhile ; forehead hot ; 4th day.
Frontal headache, weighty. θ Typhus.
Dull, heavy headache, > from pressure on nasal bones and < from mental labor.
Fulness of head, with fluctuation when walking.
Frontal headache : with pressure at root of nose ; with feeling of fulness and tightness of whole head.
Pressive pain in forehead as if it would be pressed in, with sharp pains in both temples ; much < from motion.
Sharp darts of pain in supraorbital nerve at foramen.
Dull pain in anterior lobes of brain and right frontal sinus ; afternoon.
Severe pain passing from insertion of right sterno-mastoid muscle through head into orbit, causing a dull, heavy feeling in head, especially forehead, > by pressing below mastoid process.
Beating headache in forehead, with soreness in back of head, immediately below occipital protuberance, followed by hot stitches in temples.
Frequent pain in right temple ; sharp pain by spells in both.
Heavy pain at base of brain, with lameness and drawing in cervical muscles.
Fulness in head with pain behind right ear ; > having lain quiet for a short time.
Headache and pain behind right ear, > after dinner.
Severe pain in occiput with dull, stupid feeling all over head ; sharp pain over eyes.
Dull feeling in occiput, with pain and fulness of vessels.
Throbbing in head, over eyes, with weakness in limbs on going up-stairs.
Dull bruised ache in head. θ Typhus.
Dull, bruised feeling in occiput. θ Diphtheria.
Soreness as if in brain, frontal region, with pain, heat, vertigo ; < on stooping.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Bapt.]
Top of head feels as if it would fly off.
Great tightness of forehead.
Scalp feels sore.
Sensation as if head was swelling (slowly growing larger and larger), with pain at insertion of sterno-cleido-mastoid muscle accompanied by a sensation as if head was swollen behind ear, right side.
Dull, bruised ache in head. θ Typhus.
Several sharp thrusts of pain in head over right eye.
Fulness of external vessels of head and face.
Neck feels so tired, she can't hold her head easy in any position.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Bapt.]
Cannot bear light ; eyes burn, but do not water. θ Chronic sore eyes.
Eyes weak.
Occasionally delirium with confusion of sight. θ Diphtheria.
Feeling as if eyes would be pressed into head ; eyeballs feel sore with great confusion of sight ; cannot place anything, until after looking at it a few seconds ; everything appears to move.
Severe pain in eyes while reading, compelled to stop.
Severe pain in left eye, < from pressing on crown of head, with dull headache.
Eyes dull. θ Typhus.
Left eye for a moment feels very weak, followed by stitches in upper eyelid.
Stitches in right eye ; also in left as from needles.
Sharp pain over right eye, then over left.
Weight over eyes. θ Typhus.
Bloated feeling of eyes, glistening ; disposition to have them half closed.
Eyes feel swollen, slight lachrymation with burning.
Eyeballs feel sore ; sore and lame on moving them.
Soreness in front of head when moving eyes or turning them upward.
Vessels congested, eyes look red, inflamed.
Eyes still injected with burning pain in them, causing running of right nostril ; < from reading and from light of candle.
Eyes in morning still injected and pain, and contain thick, yellow pus, which cause them to burn ; < while reading.
Chronic sore eyes.
Partial paralysis of lids ; difficulty in keeping them open.
Pain in region of supraorbital nerve, > from pressure.
Pain in orbital plate of superior maxillary bone (left eye), relieved by pressure.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Bapt.]
Dull hearing. θ Typhus.
Roaring in ears with mental confusion.
Delirium with almost complete deafness. θ Diphtheria.
Ears feel hot and burn, yet cold to touch.
Right ear sore and neck tired.
Soreness in right ear, running down neck.
Pain below left ear, midway between mastoid process and angle of lower jaw.
Slight pain in left parotid gland.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Bapt.]
Soreness extends to posterior nares.
Severe drawing pains along nose.
Right nostril stopped up.
Nose stopped up as if had taken a bad cold ; when sneezing and blowing nose, slight bleeding from left nostril of bright red blood (thick) ; 2d day.
Thick mucus from nose.
Dull pain at root of nose. θ Catarrh.
Sneezing and feeling as after taking cold.
Crampy sensation at root of nose.
Unpleasant sensation at root of nose (especially left), as if water had passed through posterior nares while drinking.
Epistaxis and oozing of dark blood from nose for two or three days. θ Typhus.
Sensation of great fulness, œdematous swelling of affected parts, especially in choanæ. θ Diphtheria.
